hero.title: Every order inspected before it ships
hero.lead: YIXINOU supplies ICs, transistors, connectors, capacitors, resistors, sensors, switches, LEDs and modules to buyers who cannot afford a bad lot. Components are checked on arrival at our Shenzhen facility, and anything that needs internal analysis goes to our partner laboratories.
points: Incoming inspection on every order we receive
External visual inspection under a digital microscope
Internal analysis and electrical testing by our partner laboratories
An inspection record kept for the lots we ship
hero.alt: A YIXINOU inspector operating a digital inspection microscope at his work station, with the magnified component shown on the screen beside him

checks.title: Four things we do on every order

items.title: Agreed Sampling
items.text: We agree the sampling plan with you before we start, and adapt it to the part, the quantity and your own acceptance criteria.

items.title: Visual Inspection
items.text: External checks under a digital microscope for damaged, re-marked or mismatched parts, plus lead, scrape, acetone and marking-permanency testing.

items.title: Inspection Records
items.text: We keep the inspection result, the photographs and the lot and date codes for every shipment, so you can trace what was checked.

items.title: Reporting To Your Format
items.text: Tell us what your report needs to contain and we will include the findings with your shipment.

process.title: Our Quality Process
process.statement: Practical inspection equipment applied to every order we handle — and a partner laboratory whenever a part needs deeper analysis.
process.note: Steps 1 to 3 are carried out at our own facility in Shenzhen. Steps 4 and 5 are carried out by our partner laboratories — YIXINOU does not operate its own testing laboratory, and we say so plainly so you know exactly who tests your parts.

steps.title: Photography and Review
text: We count and organise your components by part and serial number, and photograph them as received.
We record the quantity and country of origin, then give each lot its own lot and date code.
steps.alt: Electronic component reels, trays and anti-static bags laid out in labelled rows on the sorting floor at the YIXINOU facility

steps.title: Barcode Scanning and Review
text: A second review confirms exact quantities and specifications against your order.
Labels are scanned into our records, so each part stays traceable to the lot it came from.
steps.alt: Illustration: a handheld barcode scanner reading the label of a sealed anti-static bag held over a bench

steps.title: Visual Inspection
text: Our inspectors examine components externally under a digital inspection microscope.
We check for damaged, re-marked or mismatched parts, and run lead inspection, scrape testing, acetone testing and marking permanency testing.
steps.alt: A YIXINOU inspector positioning a component under a digital inspection microscope, with the magnified surface of the part displayed on the monitor behind

steps.title: Laboratory Inspection and Testing
text: Parts that need internal analysis are sent to our partner laboratories, where their engineers carry out advanced testing using X-ray, X-ray Fluorescence (XRF) and high-magnification microscopy.
Their laboratories also perform heated and chemical decapsulation to verify that a part is genuine, together with solderability testing to confirm the leads or terminations can be reliably soldered.
steps.alt: Illustration: X-ray inspection cabinet, XRF analyser and inspection microscope on a partner laboratory bench with a tray of component samples

steps.title: Electrical Testing
text: Electrical performance is measured at our partner laboratories against the part's datasheet specification.
Their engineers use curve tracers, functional testing, or inductance, capacitance and resistance (LCR) measurement to characterise active and passive parts.
steps.alt: Illustration: curve tracer and LCR test bench with a component held in a test fixture and measurement traces on screen

midCta.title: Tell us what your parts need to pass
midCta.text: Send us your acceptance criteria — sampling level, tests required and report format — and we will confirm exactly how we will check your order before it reaches you.

blocks.title: Suppliers we can stand behind
blocks.text: We buy from suppliers we have qualified and we keep the ones that perform. Suppliers with reported quality issues are restricted or removed from our list. Where a part’s history cannot be verified, we tell you rather than ship it as certain.
blocks.alt: High-bay racking holding palletised electronic components in the YIXINOU warehouse

blocks.title: A record for every lot
blocks.text: Every shipment is logged with its inspection result, its photographs and its lot and date codes. If you need to know what was checked on a specific lot, we can pull the record and send it to you.
blocks.alt: YIXINOU staff at their work stations maintaining the inspection and shipment records

items.title: Inspection Reporting

items.text: Arrange X-ray, XRF, decapsulation, solderability or electrical testing through our partner laboratories.

items.title: Certifications
items.text: Browse the certifications and cross-industry memberships that back our quality services.

faq.title: Questions buyers ask us about quality

items.a: Partly. Incoming inspection, photography, barcode review and external visual inspection under a digital microscope are carried out in-house at our Shenzhen facility. Internal analysis — X-ray, XRF, decapsulation, solderability and electrical testing — is carried out by our partner laboratories.
Our partner laboratories. YIXINOU does not operate its own testing laboratory, and we state that plainly so you know exactly who is testing your parts.

items.q: Can I get an inspection report with my order?
items.a: Yes. Tell us what your report needs to contain and we will include the findings, photographs and lot records with your shipment.

items.q: What happens if you find a problem?
items.a: We stop the lot and come back to you with what we found and the evidence behind it, rather than shipping it and hoping it passes your incoming check.

items.q: How much of my order do you check?
items.a: We agree the sampling plan with you before we start. Larger quantities, mixed lots and unverified sources are checked more heavily.

closing.text: Every part inspected. See what’s available.

AD5544ARSZ-REEL7.title: Quad 16-bit current-output DAC
AD5544ARSZ-REEL7.category: Integrated Circuits (ICS) / Data Converters / Digital to Analog Converters (DAC)
AD5544ARSZ-REEL7.summary: The AD5544ARSZ-REEL7 is a quad, 16-bit, current-output digital-to-analogue converter from Analog Devices, supplied in a 28-lead SSOP package on tape and reel. It carries four independent DAC channels behind a 3-wire SPI-compatible serial interface and settles to +/-1 LSB in 900 ns typical. Because the output is a current rather than a voltage, a precision op-amp is needed to make the current-to-voltage conversion. It runs from a 3 V to 5.5 V supply and is specified from -40 °C to +125 °C.
AD5544ARSZ-REEL7.alt: A 28-lead SSOP package, the package used for the AD5544ARSZ-REEL7 quad 16-bit DAC
AD5544ARSZ-REEL7.imageNote: Illustrative package image. Ask us for a photograph of the actual lot.
AD5544ARSZ-REEL7.about: The AD5544 family is built for systems that need several tightly matched 16-bit channels in one package rather than a separate converter per channel. Each of the four DACs is current-output, so the design pairs the part with a precision op-amp for the current-to-voltage stage and a stable voltage reference for the +/-10 V reference input. It also works in four-quadrant multiplying mode, which lets a varying reference scale the output. Typical homes are precision instruments, automated test equipment, industrial process control and medical imaging, where the per-channel cost and the matched channel-to-channel behaviour matter more than raw speed.
standards: Analog Devices AD5544/AD5554 datasheet Rev. F
RoHS compliant
ESD-sensitive device — handle under ESD-protected conditions
features: Four independent 16-bit DAC channels in one package
Current output, converted to voltage with an external op-amp
applications: Programmable power supplies and bias circuits

faq.q: What is the AD5544ARSZ-REEL7 used for?
faq.a: It is used where a design needs four matched 16-bit analogue outputs in a small footprint: precision instruments, automated test equipment, industrial process control loops, medical imaging front ends, and programmable bias or supply rails. Because the output is a current, it suits designs that already need a precision op-amp stage, and the +/-10 V reference input lets the output span be scaled by an external reference in multiplying applications.

faq.q: What do buyers check before ordering an AD5544ARSZ-REEL7?
faq.a: The first question is whether the design can take a current-output DAC at all, because that decision adds a precision op-amp and a reference to the bill of materials. After that buyers compare INL and DNL against the accuracy budget, check whether the 16-bit resolution of this part is needed over the 14-bit AD5543/AD5545 siblings, confirm the reference source and its temperature drift, and satisfy themselves that the parts are original Analog Devices material in factory packaging rather than reworked or downgraded stock.

faq.q: How does YIXINOU check an AD5544ARSZ-REEL7 before it ships?
faq.a: Incoming inspection at our Shenzhen facility checks the SSOP-28 body and lead coplanarity, the laser marking against the expected Analog Devices format, and the factory packaging and labelling. Laboratory analysis — X-ray, XRF, decapsulation, solderability and electrical testing — is carried out by our partner laboratories; YIXINOU does not operate its own testing laboratory. Tell us what your design needs proven and we will say plainly which checks were done and who performed them.

AD633JRZ-RL.title: Four-quadrant analogue multiplier
AD633JRZ-RL.category: Integrated Circuits (ICS) / Linear ICs / Analog Multipliers
AD633JRZ-RL.summary: The AD633JRZ-RL is a four-quadrant analogue multiplier from Analog Devices in an 8-lead SOIC package, supplied on tape and reel. It computes W = (X1 - X2)(Y1 - Y2) / 10 V + Z using laser-trimmed internal resistors, so it needs no external trimming components. Inputs accept +/-10 V and the small-signal output bandwidth is 1 MHz. The J grade used here is specified from 0 °C to +70 °C and runs from a +/-8 V to +/-18 V dual supply.
AD633JRZ-RL.alt: An 8-lead SOIC AD633J analogue multiplier with its date code visible on the package
AD633JRZ-RL.imageNote: Photograph of this part. Lot marking and date code vary by shipment — ask us for a photograph of the actual lot.
AD633JRZ-RL.about: The AD633 is the low-cost multiplier in the Analog Devices analogue-function line: it multiplies two analogue signals and sums an optional Z input, which is what makes it useful for gain control, modulation and power measurement rather than for arithmetic alone. On-chip laser trimming removes the external trim network that older multipliers required. The J grade in this part number is the commercial temperature grade, so it fits benchtop instruments, teaching and consumer-grade signal processing; designs that have to hold accuracy over a wider temperature range should look at the A, B or S grades instead.
standards: Analog Devices AD633 datasheet Rev. K
RoHS compliant
ESD-sensitive device — handle under ESD-protected conditions
features: Transfer function W = (X1 - X2)(Y1 - Y2) / 10 V + Z
Laser-trimmed for accuracy, no external trim network

faq.q: What is the AD633JRZ-RL used for?
faq.a: It multiplies two analogue signals in hardware, which is how designers build instantaneous power measurement, voltage-controlled gain and amplitude modulation without moving the signal into the digital domain. It also works as a divider by placing it inside an op-amp feedback loop. Typical users are instrument designers, power-metering engineers, AGC stages and university laboratories.

faq.q: What do buyers check before ordering an AD633JRZ-RL?
faq.a: The grade is the first thing to confirm, because the J suffix is the commercial 0 °C to +70 °C part and an industrial design needs the A, B or S grade instead. Buyers then check the roughly 2 % total error against their accuracy budget and its drift over temperature, confirm the board can supply a bipolar rail, and compare against the AD834 and AD835 multipliers, which differ in bandwidth and output configuration.

faq.q: How does YIXINOU check an AD633JRZ-RL before it ships?
faq.a: Incoming inspection at our Shenzhen facility checks the SOIC-8 lead coplanarity and body finish, verifies the laser marking and date code format against what Analog Devices prints on this family, and confirms the reel and factory labelling. Laboratory analysis — X-ray, XRF, decapsulation, solderability and electrical testing — is carried out by our partner laboratories; YIXINOU does not operate its own testing laboratory. Ask us and we will state which checks were performed on your lot.

AD780BRZ-REEL7.title: 2.5 V / 3.0 V high-precision voltage reference
AD780BRZ-REEL7.category: Integrated Circuits (ICS) / Power Management ICs / Voltage References
AD780BRZ-REEL7.summary: The AD780BRZ-REEL7 is a high-precision series voltage reference from Analog Devices, supplied in an 8-lead SOIC package on tape and reel. It delivers either 2.5 V or 3.0 V from a pin-selectable output, with initial accuracy of +/-1 mV maximum and 3 ppm/°C temperature drift in the B grade. Input range is 4 V to 36 V and the output can source or sink up to +/-10 mA. Low-frequency noise is 4 uV p-p from 0.1 Hz to 10 Hz, and the part is specified from -40 °C to +85 °C.
AD780BRZ-REEL7.alt: An 8-lead SOIC AD780B voltage reference with its lot and date code visible
AD780BRZ-REEL7.imageNote: Photograph of this part. Lot marking and date code vary by shipment — ask us for a photograph of the actual lot.
AD780BRZ-REEL7.about: The AD780 is one of the reference benchmarks designers reach for when an ADC or DAC budget has to hold over temperature. The B grade used in this part number is the tight-drift option: 3 ppm/°C with a +/-1 mV initial error, which is what lets a 16-bit converter keep its last bits meaningful. The output is pin-programmable between 2.5 V and 3.0 V, so one part number covers both common system rails, and the wide 4 V to 36 V input means it can run directly from an unregulated rail. It is normally specified alongside precision data acquisition, instrumentation and calibration hardware rather than in general-purpose power design.
standards: Analog Devices AD780 datasheet Rev. K
RoHS and REACH compliant
ESD-sensitive device — handle under ESD-protected conditions
applications: Reference for precision ADC and DAC systems

faq.q: What is the AD780BRZ-REEL7 used for?
faq.a: It supplies the stable reference voltage that a precision converter measures against, which makes it a direct contributor to system accuracy. It appears in instrumentation, medical devices, data acquisition front ends and calibration equipment where the last few bits of a 14- or 16-bit converter have to stay meaningful over temperature.

faq.q: What do buyers check before ordering an AD780BRZ-REEL7?
faq.a: Grade and drift come first: the B grade in this part number carries 3 ppm/°C, while the A and C grades trade accuracy for cost, so buying the wrong suffix is the usual mistake. Buyers then check how the 2.5 V / 3.0 V selection pin is wired on their board, the load regulation and decoupling requirements, and whether the reference drift still leaves headroom once the converter error budget is combined with it.

faq.q: How does YIXINOU check an AD780BRZ-REEL7 before it ships?
faq.a: Incoming inspection at our Shenzhen facility checks lead coplanarity and body marking on the SOIC-8 package, verifies the lot and date code format, and confirms that the reel and factory labels match the part number ordered. Laboratory analysis — X-ray, XRF, decapsulation, solderability and electrical testing — is carried out by our partner laboratories; YIXINOU does not operate its own testing laboratory. Ask us and we will tell you which checks were run on your lot.

AD7928BRUZ-REEL7.title: 8-channel 12-bit 1 MSPS SAR ADC
AD7928BRUZ-REEL7.category: Integrated Circuits (ICS) / Data Converters / Analog to Digital Converters (ADC)
AD7928BRUZ-REEL7.summary: The AD7928BRUZ-REEL7 is an 8-channel, 12-bit successive-approximation ADC from Analog Devices in a 20-lead TSSOP package on tape and reel. It converts at up to 1 MSPS with a 70 dB minimum signal-to-noise ratio and talks over a serial interface compatible with SPI, QSPI, MICROWIRE and DSP ports. Each input spans 0 V to the reference, and the part offers an internal 2.5 V reference option or accepts an external one. Supply range is 2.7 V to 5.25 V and it is specified from -40 °C to +85 °C.
AD7928BRUZ-REEL7.alt: A 20-lead TSSOP AD7928 8-channel 12-bit ADC with its date code visible
AD7928BRUZ-REEL7.imageNote: Photograph of this part. Lot marking and date code vary by shipment — ask us for a photograph of the actual lot.
specs: SPI / QSPI / MICROWIRE / DSP compatible serial
AD7928BRUZ-REEL7.about: The AD7928 packs eight analogue inputs and an on-chip sequencer into a 20-lead TSSOP, which is the point of the part: a design that would otherwise need a multiplexer plus a single-channel converter gets one device and one serial interface. The sequencer walks the channels without host intervention, so a slow microcontroller can still scan eight sensors at 1 MSPS aggregate. The internal 2.5 V reference suits compact designs, while an external reference is the way to go when the accuracy budget demands better drift than the internal one offers. It is common in industrial control, multi-channel data acquisition and power monitoring.
standards: Analog Devices AD7908/AD7918/AD7928 datasheet Rev. E
RoHS compliant
ESD-sensitive device — handle under ESD-protected conditions
features: 8 analogue input channels with on-chip sequencer
Serial interface compatible with SPI, QSPI, MICROWIRE and DSP
Internal 2.5 V reference option, external reference supported
0 V to VREF analogue input span

faq.q: What is the AD7928BRUZ-REEL7 used for?
faq.a: It reads eight analogue signals at once and hands them to a processor over a serial bus, which is why it shows up in industrial control racks, multi-channel data acquisition cards, power monitoring and portable instruments. It is the right choice when the channel count, not raw resolution, is what the design is short of.

faq.q: What do buyers check before ordering an AD7928BRUZ-REEL7?
faq.a: Channel count is the first filter, because the AD7927 and AD7908 in the same family have different numbers of inputs and a buyer who needs six channels should not pay for eight. After that the checks are the SPI clock rate against the 1 MSPS throughput, the input range and the protection circuitry in front of it, whether the internal reference is accurate enough or an external one is required, and how much crosstalk the layout allows between adjacent channels.

faq.q: How does YIXINOU check an AD7928BRUZ-REEL7 before it ships?
faq.a: Incoming inspection at our Shenzhen facility checks the TSSOP-20 lead coplanarity and body condition, verifies the laser marking and date code against the expected Analog Devices format, and confirms the reel and factory labelling. Laboratory analysis — X-ray, XRF, decapsulation, solderability and electrical testing — is carried out by our partner laboratories; YIXINOU does not operate its own testing laboratory. Tell us what needs proving and we will report exactly which checks were done.

AD8009ARZ-REEL7.title: 1 GHz current-feedback operational amplifier
AD8009ARZ-REEL7.category: Integrated Circuits (ICS) / Linear ICs / High-Speed Operational Amplifiers
AD8009ARZ-REEL7.summary: The AD8009ARZ-REEL7 is a current-feedback operational amplifier from Analog Devices in an 8-lead SOIC package on tape and reel. It delivers 1 GHz bandwidth at unity gain, a 5500 V/us slew rate and 545 ps rise time, with -78 dBc distortion at 5 MHz and 110 mA output drive. It runs from a +/-5 V supply and is specified from -40 °C to +85 °C. Because it is a current-feedback topology, the feedback resistor value sets the bandwidth and has to follow the datasheet recommendation.

It runs at up to 20MHz and combines 32kB of flash, 2kB SRAM and 1kB EEPROM over a 1.8V to 5.5V supply. faq.q: What is the H5CGD8MGBDX021N used for?

faq.q: What do buyers check before ordering an H5CGD8MGBDX021N?

faq.q: How does YIXINOU check an H5CGD8MGBDX021N before it ships?
